name: moltalk
description: Draw, rotate and name organic molecules with RDKit: verified names, IUPAC numbering, R/S and E/Z, lone pairs, a ChemDraw-style 3D view, and ChemDraw/MOL/SDF export.

interface.longDescription: Ask about any molecule and MolTalk draws it inline: a clean 2D structure you can grab and rotate in 3D, with verified names (bundled library, OPSIN, PubChem), IUPAC numbering, R/S and E/Z labels, lone pairs, and export to SVG/PNG or ChemDraw, MOL, SDF, PDB and XYZ files. It never guesses a structure: unknown or ambiguous names are reported, not invented.
